elements.requirement: This Part applies to premises that consist of or include a dwelling and are not held under a tenancy to which Part II of the Landlord and Tenant Act 1954 applies.
elements.quote: applies to premises which consist of or include a dwelling and are not held under a tenancy to which Part II of the Landlord and Tenant Act 1954 applies

elements.requirement: This Part does not apply to a dwelling if the dwelling is located in Wales and is subject to an occupation contract under section 7 of the Renting Homes (Wales) Act 2016.
elements.quote: this Part does not apply if the dwelling is in Wales and is subject to an occupation contract

elements.requirement: In this Part, the expression 'service charge' has the meaning assigned to it by section 18(1) of the Landlord and Tenant Act 1985.
elements.quote: “service charge” has the meaning given by section 18(1) of the 1985 Act

elements.requirement: In this Part, the expression 'administration charge' has the meaning assigned to it by paragraph 1 of Schedule 11 to the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002.
elements.quote: “administration charge” has the meaning given by paragraph 1 of Schedule 11 to the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002
